sample_unit: inpatients with T2DM (1,275 internal, 292 external EHR cohort)

links.outcome: Expert-rated correctness and alignment of AI explanations after doctor-in-the-loop refinement
links.effect: Final XAI system explanations showed strong alignment with experts' explanations and increased correctness by expert evaluation; unreasonable explanations were reduced versus other explanation models.
links.quote: The final XAI system explanations demonstrated strong alignment with experts' explanations and increased correctness by expert evaluation

links.outcome: Clinician insulin titration accuracy and confidence with versus without STII-DIL assistance
links.effect: Accuracy significantly improved for junior clinicians with STII-DIL assistance, while senior clinicians showed minimal change; both groups reported increased confidence.
links.quote: An AI-human collaboration study revealed that insulin titration accuracy significantly improved for junior clinicians with STII-DIL assistance, while senior clinicians showed minimal change.

unlisted_practices: Doctor-in-the-loop iterative refinement of XAI explanations by encoding clinical constraints

screen.reason: Evaluates the impact of an explainable AI framework (STII-DIL) on junior and senior clinicians' insulin titration decision accuracy and confidence in a human-AI collaboration study.

primary.practice: explainable AI (XAI) assistance with clinician-in-the-loop refinement
